jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Du bist Softwareentwickler:in, möchtest aber mehr als vorgegebene Tickets umsetzen? Bei uns verbindest du Full-Stack-Entwicklung mit fachlichem Verständnis und gestaltest digitale Lösungen vom Problem bis zum produktiven Einsatz.

Bei esveo arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle von Fachbereich, Software und AI. Gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden entwickelst du aus Prozessen, Daten und Ideen tragfähige digitale Lösungen und bringst sie selbst in die Umsetzung. Dabei arbeitest du nicht nur an Frontend und Backend, sondern gestaltest auch Konzeption, Architektur und Lösungsfindung aktiv mit. Moderne AI-Werkzeuge unterstützen dich dabei, schneller von der Idee zu einem produktiv einsetzbaren Ergebnis zu kommen

Aufgaben

Du arbeitest dich in die Prozesse, Daten, Systeme und Ziele unserer Kunden ein und entwickelst ein tiefes Verständnis für ihre tatsächlichen Herausforderungen.

Du hinterfragst Anforderungen und übersetzt fachliche Probleme in konkrete Lösungsideen, Prototypen, Spezifikationen und umsetzbare Arbeitspakete.

Du programmierst selbst und entwickelst anspruchsvolle digitale Lösungen, je nach Projekt beispielsweise in Anwendungslogik, Frontend, Backend, Schnittstellen, Automatisierungen oder AI-Komponenten.

Du setzt Agentic Coding Tools wie Claude Code, Codex, Cursor oder GitHub Copilot strukturiert ein und überprüfst die Ergebnisse durch Tests und Reviews.

Du triffst fachliche und technische Entscheidungen gemeinsam mit Kunden und Team und kannst ihre Auswirkungen verständlich erklären.

Du begleitest Vorhaben von der ersten Analyse über Konzeption und Umsetzung bis zum produktiven Einsatz und übernimmst Verantwortung für Nutzen, Qualität und Projekterfolg.

Qualifikation

Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Entwicklung anspruchsvoller digitaler Lösungen oder in technischer Projekt- oder Produktarbeit mit hohem Umsetzungsanteil.

Du kannst fachliche Zusammenhänge schnell erfassen und mit Kunden auf Augenhöhe über Prozesse, Anforderungen und Lösungsmöglichkeiten sprechen.

Du verfügst über fundierte Programmierkenntnisse und ein gutes Verständnis von Softwarearchitektur, APIs, Datenmodellen und Tests. So kannst du Lösungen selbst implementieren und weiterentwickeln, fundierte Architekturentscheidungen treffen und die Qualität von Implementierungen beurteilen.

Du hast Erfahrung mit modernen, professionellen Technologie-Stacks – zum Beispiel TypeScript und Node.js, C# und .NET oder vergleichbaren typisierten Sprachen und Plattformen.

Du nutzt AI-Tools nicht nur für einzelne Code-Vorschläge, sondern auch für Analyse, Spezifikation, Umsetzung, Testing und Review.

Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, kommunizierst direkt und machst Risiken, Abhängigkeiten und offene Entscheidungen frühzeitig sichtbar.

Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden dein Profil ab.

Benefits

Leistungsstarker Laptop und zwei 25-Zoll-Bildschirme

Tastatur und Maus ganz nach deiner Wahl

Arbeiten mit modernen Web-, Cloud- und AI-Technologien

Viel Gestaltungsfreiraum und Verantwortung für echte Ergebnisse

Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege

Direkter Austausch in einem kompetenten und motivierten Team

Individuelle Förderung und viele Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten

Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle und mobiles Arbeiten

Kostenlose Getränke und Snacks

Gemeinsames Mittagessen am Freitag und regelmäßige Teamevents

Das klingt spannend? Dann bewirb dich jetzt bei uns und werde Teil unseres Teams!

jobs.title: Senior Web Developer - Tools
jobs.description:
At Rockstar Games, we create world-class entertainment experiences.

Become part of a team working on some of the most rewarding, large-scale creative projects to be found in any entertainment medium - all within an inclusive, highly-motivated environment where you can learn and collaborate with some of the most talented people in the industry.

Rockstar is on the lookout for a passionate Web Developer with strong experience in React and .NET to help build modern, scalable applications that help power our complex productions. This role works closely with designers, back-end engineers and stakeholders across the organisation to deliver high quality user experiences.

This is a full-time, permanent and in-office position based in Rockstar’s state-of-the-art game development studio in Dundee, Scotland.

What We Do

The Rockstar Games Tools Team create and maintain software tools that are used by all game development disciplines to support the creation of all Rockstar Games projects.

Responsibilities

Design and develop complex, high performance web applications that are the backbone of project management and collaboration across our projects.
Development of accessible front-end components and applications using React.
Integration of front-end applications with ASP.NET Core (C#).
Contribute to architectural decisions and continuous improvement of the code base.
Develop comprehensive test suites.
Web performance optimization.

Requirements

A degree in computer science or 5+ years of experience in professional web development.
5+ years of experience using React.
5+ years of experience using .NET.
Experience with real-time technologies e.g. WebSockets, SignalR.
Experience with automated testing, shared code, and source control.
Knowledge of Agile, software development, and web-security best practices.
Passion for web technologies and a desire to remain up to date with the latest technologies.

PLUSES

Please note that these are desirable skills and are not required to apply for the position.

Knowledge of authentication/authorization systems e.g. OAuth, identity providers.
Experience working on chat, collaboration or messaging platforms.
Understanding of UI/UX principles and/or working closely with design systems.
Exposure to Elasticsearch/OpenSearch.
Exposure to observability tools.
Knowledge of Rockstar’s game titles and passion for playing video games.

How To Apply

Please apply with a CV and cover letter demonstrating how you meet the skills above. If we would like to move forward with your application, a Rockstar recruiter will reach out to you to explain next steps and guide you through the process.

Rockstar is committed to creating a work environment that promotes equal opportunity, dignity and respect. In line with this commitment, Rockstar will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified job applicants with disabilities during the recruitment process in order for such applicants to be considered for the position for which they are applying, as well as to qualified employees to enable them to perform the essential functions of their roles. If you need more information about Rockstar’s reasonable accommodation policies or process, or need to request an accommodation, please notify your recruiter during the interview process.

If you’ve got the right skills for the job, we want to hear from you. We encourage applications from all suitable candidates regardless of age, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, belief, race, or any other protected category.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.description:
About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

Tripadvisor Experiences Engineering
is the team that builds and supports the world's leading marketplace for travel experiences
. We believe that making memories is what travel is all about. And with 400,000+ travel experiences to explore—everything from simple tours to extreme adventures (and everything in between) —making memories that will last a lifetime has never been easier.

About The Role

We’re looking for a product-focused Software Engineer II
to join our fast-growing Experiences Engineering team. This is a full-stack role, leveraging Java, SQL, React, AWS and AI tools
. It’s ideal for mid-level engineers who enjoy solving complex problems, shipping frequently, and working in a modern cloud environment. You’ll play a key role in building high-impact features that power millions of traveler experiences globally.

We embrace flexibility in where and how work gets done and also value meaningful in-person moments to connect and collaborate. You can expect a remote-first working model
with periodic in-person gatherings at your closest office for team connection, planning, or other key moments. This position is open to candidates based within a commutable distance (generally up to 1.5 hours) of one of our office hubs in Oxford.

What You’ll Do

Drive Impact: Connect your engineering work directly to traveler value by owning features from design to deployment.
Shape the Product: Partner with product, design, and data teams to influence what we build, helping to define specifications and find the most efficient path to success.
Collaborate & Mentor: Review code, provide thoughtful feedback, and coach less experienced engineers to maintain a high bar for quality.
Innovate with AI: Use agentic AI as a daily partner to plan approaches, automate routine tasks, and focus your energy on solving more complex technical challenges.
Champion Operational Health: Take hands-on ownership of system reliability by building monitoring dashboards, managing alerts and support cases, and fixing underlying bugs to continuously improve service resilience and eliminate operational toil.
Build for Quality: Design and implement clean, maintainable solutions with a focus on performance, security, and automated testing.

Skills & Experience

We typically look for a minimum of 2-3 years’ experience, following a Bachelor’s degree or above in Comp Science or a related field.

Full-Stack Mindset: Experience developing web apps, including proficiency in a modern backend language (e.g., Java, C#, Go, Python) and familiarity with relational databases.
Problem Solving: A strong grasp of computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms) and the ability to apply them to real-world distributed systems.
Data-Driven: A habit of using operational data and experiment results to validate that your changes had the intended effect.
AI Coding: you are fluent coding with either Cursor or Codex/Claude/Open Code.
Global Mindset: Ability to operate effectively within a global team, communicating clearly about progress and blockers.

We don’t expect you to know everything on day one. However, we’re especially interested if you’ve had exposure to AWS, React, or NoSQL databases. More than any specific tool, we value curiosity and the ability to solve problems creatively.

We value engineers from different technical backgrounds. You can complete our coding interview exercises
in any language of your choice, but need to be open to working within the Java ecosystem when you join!

What We Offer

Competitive compensation packages, including base salary, annual bonus, and more.
“Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. We take a remote-friendly approach to collaboration, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like in select locations.
Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveller first: We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.
Execution is our edge: We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.
We succeed together: The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

Discover more in our Tech Blog, for an inside look into some of our exciting and ground-breaking technical projects here at Tripadvisor Group.

Tripadvisor Group champions the unique identities, abilities, and experiences of all our people – employees, customers, and partners. This stems from our belief in the transformative power of travel, dining, and experiences to connect us and open doors to worlds very different from our own. Our ED&I strategy shapes how we approach our people, culture, business, and reputation. Tripadvisor Group strives to embed inclusion and belonging across all our brands.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com
.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com
. We have all the answers!

This role will focus on expanding API functionality across both ReliaSoft Desktop and ReliaSoft Cloud, enabling enterprise integrations, automation, and future AI/LLM-powered features.

You will work closely with product owners, software architects, and development teams across the US and UK to build scalable, secure, and high-performance services that support the long-term modernization of the ReliaSoft platform.

Design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs for ReliaSoft Desktop and ReliaSoft Cloud.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer - Service Delivery/IX Platform
jobs.description:
We are seeking an Engineer
to join our global IX Platform team, where innovation knows no borders. This role is part of a larger transition and a dedicated team being created in Kraków. This team designs, builds, and evolves modern cloud-native backend services and distributed architectures that power mission-critical travel and airline technology solutions worldwide. By delivering high-availability systems, robust APIs, and scalable data flows, the team enables travel disruptors and established leaders to retail, distribute, and fulfill travel at scale. With an inclusive culture and flexible work environment, we work together with boldness, curiosity, and commitment so we can all win together.

As an Engineer on the IX Platform team in Kraków, you will build and support resilient microservices, messaging patterns, and cloud-native backend components. You will collaborate across Product, Architecture, QA, SRE, and Delivery teams to translate platform vision into production-ready software. Takes ownership of services from design through implementation, deployment, and production support. This role demands strong backend engineering fundamentals, a commitment to clean code, and constructive problem-solving to maintain high reliability across enterprise distributed systems.

What You'll Do

Service Lifecycle: Take ownership of services from design through implementation, deployment, and production support.
Backend Engineering: Design, develop, test, and maintain high-performance backend services using Java and modern JDK capabilities.
API Development: Build, consume, and document secure, well-structured RESTful and SOAP APIs and integration services for high-availability systems.
Cloud Operations: Deploy and operate containerized microservices in cloud environments, focusing on Google Cloud Platform, GKE, Cloud Run, and automated deployment patterns.
Distributed Systems: Implement asynchronous, event-driven communication patterns using messaging technologies, queues, and event streams.
Data Management: Optimize relational database schemas, SQL queries, transactions, caching mechanisms, and data access layers for consistency and scale.
Quality & Code Health: Author production-quality code with unit and integration tests, participate in code reviews, and drive continuous engineering improvements.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional teams to refine technical requirements, evaluate design trade-offs, and support operational readiness through logging, monitoring, and incident diagnostics.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

Strong hands-on experience with Java backend development, modern JDK versions, JVM fundamentals, concurrency, and performance tuning.
Proven experience designing, developing, consuming, and maintaining REST and SOAP APIs, including API security, contracts, and versioning.
Practical experience with cloud-native architectures and containerization tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, or Google Cloud Platform services.
Solid understanding of distributed systems principles, microservices patterns, service discovery, resiliency, messaging systems (e.g., Pub/Sub, Kafka, RabbitMQ), and key resilience/consistency mechanisms including retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, idempotency, consistency, latency, and failure handling.
Hands-on experience with relational databases, SQL schema design, query optimization, data modeling, and modern CI/CD practices.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, or similar Java backend frameworks.
Hands-on experience with GCP-native services such as GKE, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Memorystore, Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Trace, or Cloud Build.
Experience with Kafka or high-volume event streaming platforms.
Experience designing systems for high availability, horizontal scaling, disaster recovery, and performance under load.
Experience with OpenAPI/Swagger, API gateways, OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, mTLS, enterprise identity integrations, or NoSQL/caching technologies like PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL, Redis, or Elasticsearch.
Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or Helm.
Domain experience in travel, airline, retailing, distribution, booking, or fulfillment enterprise systems.

Work arrangements

Hybrid working mode; 3 chosen days from the office in a week
Flexible working hours: Maintain your work-life balance by adjusting your working hours to your needs

Paid time off

Year-End-Break: enjoy additional fully paid days off during the last week of the year
Paid parental leave: Take up to 12 weeks off with pay after birth or adoption of a child. Sabre Global Paid Parental Leave runs concurrently with local leave policies.
Paid volunteer time: take up to 4 days annually to give your time to a charitable organization of your choice

Your money

Tax deduction: take the opportunity to claim deductible costs, reducing your income tax
Employee Capital Plans: profit from long-term saving scheme co-financed by Sabre and the State Treasury
Baby Bonus: benefit from one-time allowance on childbirth or adoption 
Say Thanks program: collect points on recognition program and transfer them to wide variety of gifts and services

Health and wellness

Luxmed medical coverage: take care of yourself and your family with the extensive medical package with a broad range of additional services
Foreign travel insurance: feel safe going abroad with free Allianz insurance offered as part of our Lux Med package
Employee Assistance Program: find help in free, confidential program with a certified counselor
Mindfulness & meditation apps: take care of your mental and physical health
Life insurance: sign up for free, high coverage life insurance program

Career development

Professional development: access to e-learning platforms as well as join Sabre live learning sessions
Certification and tuition reimbursement
Our Communities: join one of our team member groups focused on sharing knowledge and best practices (Google Developers Group, Innovation Lab Community, Women in Technology, SOLVE!T and many more)

And more

Car and bike parking
Fun & Relax zone in modern office: enjoy electronic tables to work, foosball, ping pong, pool table, swings, massage chairs and terraces to admire a panoramic view of Kraków. We have parents’ rooms as well
No dress code

jobs.title: Software Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Everyone's story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 12 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don't have to worry about it.

And there's more: We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We are looking for a

Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)

Join our team at our location in Stockholm – hybrid working conditions available.

Our solutions contribute to flexible and customer-friendly payment alternatives. We offer consumers the opportunity to choose when and how they want to pay, whilst guaranteeing a steady and predictable cashflow for merchants. Our products make us proud, but not content and we have high ambitions for our existing as well as upcoming products. We have a strong commitment to building the future of FinTech — human-centric and sustainable.

You’ll be part of a product team building and evolving reliable, scalable software in a modern engineering environment. We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, cares about code quality, and wants to have a real impact on both our products and engineering practices.

What You’ll Be Doing

Design, develop, test, and ship robust, maintainable, and readable software, applications, APIs, and workflows
Contribute to technical architecture design decisions
Work as part of an agile, cross-functional team and actively participat in Scrum ceremonies
Analyze, discuss, and implement business requirements while maintaining good documentation of the systems and components you create
Bring in industry standards and best practices to continually improve our codebase and architecture
Make a positive impact on our engineering culture by adopting, implementing, and providing feedback on both organizational and industry standards and practices

Qualifications

What you bring:

5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience with C# and .NET
Strong experience building and maintaining backend services
A solid understanding of RESTful APIs
Practical experience with data access patterns and ORMs, ideally Entity Framework
Good knowledge of relational databases, preferably SQL Server
Familiarity with distributed architectures, including service-to-service communication and asynchronous messaging
Experience with cloud-hosted and containerized applications, ideally Azure and Docker; Kubernetes is a plus
Experience troubleshooting application issues using logs and monitoring tools
Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) to speed up coding, testing, and debugging, along with sound judgment about when and how to rely on AI-generated output.
Exposure to Infrastructure as Code practices is a plus
Fluent English
FinTech or banking domain knowledge is a big plus

Please note: you need to have EU citizenship or a valid work permit for Sweden.

jobs.title: Senior .NET utvecklare
jobs.description:
Att jobba som Senior .NET utvecklare

Vi söker en senior .NET utvecklare som vill bli en del av ett team som bygger och utvecklar affärskritiska system inom försäkringsområdet. Du kommer att arbeta nära mjukvaruarkitekter, produktägare, testare och andra utvecklare för att designa, implementera och vidareutveckla högkvalitativa lösningar som är säkra, skalbara och långsiktigt hållbara.

Tillsammans med teamet deltar du i arbete kring krav, design och systemarkitektur och bidrar till välgrundade tekniska beslut. Rollen har ett tydligt fokus på backendutveckling i .NET/C#, samtidigt som du även kommer att arbeta med och vidareutveckla interna frontendlösningar i React.

Utvecklingsarbetet sker i en eventdriven arkitektur inom en säkerhetskritisk miljö med stora datamängder och höga krav på tillförlitlighet, prestanda och stabilitet. Du arbetar med integrationer mot andra system och deltar aktivt i det kontinuerliga arbetet med att förbättra kodkvalitet, tekniska lösningar och teamets arbetssätt.

För att lyckas i rollen

Vi söker dig som är svensktalande och trivs i en utvecklarroll där kvalitet, säkerhet och driftsstabila system står i fokus. Du har erfarenhet av att arbeta med affärskritiska applikationer och känner dig trygg i att ta ägandeskap för tekniska lösningar genom hela utvecklingskedjan – från idé och design till implementation, vidareutveckling och optimering.

Du har ett strukturerat och analytiskt arbetssätt och uppskattar att samarbeta nära andra utvecklare i ett teamorienterat arbetssätt. Samtidigt delar du gärna med dig av din kompetens och bidrar aktivt till att utveckla både teamets arbetssätt och de tekniska plattformarna.

Vi tror också att du är nyfiken på ny teknik och intresserad av att ligga i framkant, exempelvis inom AI-stödd systemutveckling, och ser värdet i verktyg som GitHub Copilot för att skapa ännu bättre lösningar.

Vi Söker Dig Som Har Erfarenhet Av

Systemutveckling i C# och .NET
Backendutveckling och systemintegrationer
Eventdriven arkitektur eller meddelandebaserade lösningar, gärna NServiceBus eller RabbitMQ
Utveckling av RESTful API:er
Relationsdatabaser, gärna SQL Server, samt ORM-verktyg som EF Core
Git och moderna CI/CD-flöden

Vad händer nu?

Vi jobbar med löpande urval så tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag. I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet.

Läs mer om hela vår rekryteringsprocess här.

Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Robert Blomqvist på robert.blomqvist@skandia.se

Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocess, vänligen ta kontakt med Madelene Skogh på madelene.skogh@skandia.se

Vi kommer att återkoppla till alla som söker oavsett om du går vidare eller inte.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Mer om IT

Vi på Skandia IT är stolta över att vara en kundorienterad enhet som levererar effektiva och säkra lösningar för våra kunder. Med cirka 600 engagerade medarbetare är vi mitt i en spännande transformationsresa, där vi utvecklas tillsammans och har kul på vägen. Framåt tillsammans är vårt motto! 

Vi arbetar agilt och har sedan 2017 använt oss av SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) ramverket, där leverans och kundvärde alltid står i centrum. Våra tågledningar och team, jobbar verksamhetsbaserat med aktiviteter som sprintplanering, daily stand-ups, team-synk, code reviews och retrospektiv. 

Var 12:e vecka samlas vi alla i vår ljusa och inspirerande Ljusgård på kontoret i Stockholm för 2 planeringsdagar. Planeringsperioden består av 6 tvåveckorssprintar, där den sista sprinten är en innovationssprint. Här får du chansen att, själv eller tillsammans med ditt team, utveckla och förfina våra system.

jobs.title: Senior .NET-utvecklare – API & tekniskt ledarskap
jobs.description:
Beskrivning av tjänsten

Vill du fortsätta vara hands-on i utvecklingen, men samtidigt få större möjlighet att påverka tekniska beslut och hur API-utvecklingen ska bedrivas?

Vi söker en senior .NET-utvecklare till ett mindre utvecklingsteam som arbetar med att modernisera en etablerad produkt (Lönessystemet POL). Fokus ligger på att utveckla API:er i C#/.NET med Kubernetes i en miljö där ny teknik möter befintlig arkitektur, kod och data.

Du kommer in i ett läge där det finns mycket att påverka. En del handlar om att bygga nytt, en annan om att förstå vad som redan finns och avgöra vad som ska behållas, förändras eller byggas om.

Teamet är litet och du kommer in som en nyckelperson från start. Med din seniora API-kompetens kliver du rakt in i de tekniska diskussionerna tillsammans med övriga seniora kollegor och får möjlighet att påverka både lösningar och vägval direkt. Här är det kort väg mellan idé och beslut och du får stort utrymme att förändra och förbättra. Du är samtidigt en del av det dagliga utvecklingsarbetet – det här är tekniskt ledarskap, inte personalansvar.

Vi använder givetvis AI som ett naturligt verktyg inom utvecklingen, men söker hela tiden nästa steg inom agentbaserad utveckling, som kan användas för att utveckla våra arbetssätt och lösningar.

Dina framtida arbetsuppgifter

I rollen kommer du framför allt att:

Designa och utveckla moderna API:er i C#/.NET i en Kubernetes-baserad miljö.
Vara med och modernisera vår befintliga produkt med dess legacylösningar och göra tekniska vägval för hur de ska utvecklas vidare.
Ta ansvar för API-lösningen hela vägen från design och implementation men även vara djupt delaktig i hosting, CI/CD och deployment.
Vägleda andra utvecklare och vara ett stöd i tekniska diskussioner och vägval.
Ansvara för designfrågor kring bland annat idempotency, atomicity och concurrency.
Sätta dig in i befintlig kod, datamodeller och stored procedures och bedöma vad som kan återanvändas och vad som behöver förändras.
Samarbeta med DevOps- och infrastrukturkompetenser kring drift och deployment.
Bidra till och driva utvecklingen av teamets arbetssätt, bland annat inom AI och agentbaserad utveckling.

Vi tror på värdet av att träffas och arbeta tillsammans på plats. Det skapar både ett effektivt arbetssätt och ett nära samarbete i teamet. Därför ser vi gärna att du är på vårt kontor i Solna 2–3 dagar i veckan.

Kvalifikationer för att bli framgångsrik denna roll

Vi söker dig som är en erfaren utvecklare och som är van att arbeta med API:er i komplexa systemmiljöer. För den här rollen är det särskilt viktigt att du har erfarenhet av API:er som skapar och uppdaterar verksamhetskritiska data.

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:

Mycket god erfarenhet av C#/.NET och API-utveckling, inklusive design och implementation av API:er för create- och update-operationer.
God förståelse för robust API-design, exempelvis concurrency, idempotency, retries, atomicity, transaktioner och datakonsistens.
Erfarenhet av lösningar där flera beroende databasändringar behöver genomföras tillsammans eller rullas tillbaka vid fel.
Erfarenhet av att integrera moderna API-lösningar med legacysystem och bedöma vad som kan återanvändas, behöver refaktoreras eller byggas om.
Förståelse för API:ets hela livscykel, inklusive containers, hosting, CI/CD och deployment.
Förmåga att göra välgrundade tekniska och arkitekturella vägval och förankra dem i teamet.
Förmåga att ta tekniskt ansvar och vägleda andra utvecklare, samtidigt som du själv arbetar hands-on.
Svenska i tal och skrift på professionell nivå.

Det är mycket meriterande om du har praktisk erfarenhet av Kubernetes och är van att deploya och drifta containeriserade applikationer. Erfarenhet av exempelvis Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress, kubectl, YAML och Helm är särskilt relevant för vår miljö.

Erfarenhet av Azure, tekniskt arkitekturarbete, API- och applikationssäkerhet eller AI-assisterad/agentbaserad utveckling är meriterande.

Eftersom vi är ett litet team lägger vi stor vikt vid hur du fungerar tillsammans med andra. Vi söker dig som delar med dig av det du kan och samtidigt är öppen för andras perspektiv. Du kan stå för dina tekniska bedömningar och vågar ifrågasätta när du ser en bättre väg, utan att tappa samarbetet på vägen. Du tar ansvar för det du driver och är bekväm med att ta reda på vad som behövs när allt inte är färdigdefinierat.

Som en del av rekryteringsprocessen genomförs bakgrundskontroll i form av kredit- och registerkontroll. Godkänd kontroll krävs för anställning.

Om du har några frågor eller funderingar, kontakta gärna rekryterade chef Carl Gerhardsson via mail carl.gerhardsson@cgi.com

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Låt oss som ägare omvandla verklig insikt till handling – tillsammans.

Livet på CGI bygger på ägande, lagarbete, respekt och tillhörighet. Tillsammans med oss kommer du att kunna nå din fulla potential.

Du är inbjuden att ta ägandeskap redan från första dagen i vårt arbete med att förverkliga vår dröm om att skapa en arbetsmiljö där vi trivs med att arbeta tillsammans och bidrar till framgången för vårt företag. Det är därför vi kallar oss CGI Partners snarare än anställda. Vi drar nytta av vår kollektiva framgång och tillsammans får vi möjlighet att aktivt forma vår företagsstrategi och inriktning.

Ditt arbete skapar värde. Du kommer att vara med att utveckla innovativa lösningar och bygga relationer med medarbetare och kunder samtidigt som du får tillgång till globala möjligheter att skala upp dina idéer, omfamna nya möjligheter och dra nytta av gedigen bransch- och teknikexpertis.

Du kommer att forma din karriär tillsammans med ett företag som är byggt för att växa och bestå. Du får stöd av ledare som bryr sig om din hälsa och ditt välbefinnande och ger dig möjligheter att fördjupa dina kunskaper och vidga dina vyer.

Bli en del en av världens största leverantörer av IT- och affärskonsulttjänster.

Overview

Solution Engineer, Data & AI

Help Denmark’s leading organizations turn data into real-world impact

Do you believe the best Data & AI solutions are built by people who are curious, pragmatic and willing to challenge conventional thinking?

We are looking for a Solution Engineer, Data & AI
to join Microsoft’s Cloud & AI Solution Engineering team in Denmark. You will work with some of Denmark’s most ambitious organisations, helping them modernise their data platforms, prepare their data for AI and turn new technology into measurable business outcomes.

This is not a traditional pre-sales role. You will combine deep technical expertise with creativity, commercial understanding and a hands-on approach. You will engage directly with customers, shape technical strategy and prove what is possible through architecture workshops, demonstrations, rapid prototyping, proofs of concept and collaborative build engagements.

You may come from a large technology company, a consultancy, a scale-up or a startup where you have helped build new platforms, products or capabilities from the ground up. What matters most is your ability to learn quickly, simplify complexity and turn ambitious ideas into solutions that work.

Responsibilities

Lead technical sales conversations with customer technical and business decision-makers, using consultative discovery to understand requirements and connect technology decisions to business outcomes.
Design and recommend secure, scalable, resilient, and governed Data & AI architectures across database, analytics, data engineering, integration, and AI scenarios.
Lead architecture sessions, technical workshops, demonstrations, rapid prototypes, proofs of concept, MVPs, and pilots to validate solutions and influence technical decisions.
Work hands-on with customers to address technical requirements, resolve blockers, and guide the modernization and migration of database, data, and analytics workloads.
Build trusted relationships with customer architects, engineers, developers, data leaders, and business decision-makers, acting as a technical advisor throughout the sales and solution lifecycle.
Collaborate with Microsoft account teams, specialists, Solution Engineers, engineering teams, customer success teams, and partners to develop technical plans and support successful implementation and adoption.
Maintain and grow technical expertise across Data & AI and cloud technologies, sharing customer insights, technical knowledge, and reusable practices with the wider Solution Engineering community.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Technical pre-sales, technical consulting, technology sales, solution engineering, technology delivery, or equivalent experience.
Experience working with database solutions, analytical workloads, data engineering, or related Data & AI technologies in cloud or hybrid environments.
Experience engaging with customers and technical and business stakeholders to understand requirements, communicate technical concepts, and translate customer needs into technical solutions.
Experience delivering technical engagements such as architecture workshops, demonstrations, rapid prototypes, proofs of concept, MVPs, or pilots.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with cloud-based data platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Azure SQL, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure Cosmos DB, or comparable cloud data technologies.
Knowledge of cloud architecture principles, including security, scalability, resiliency, governance, performance, and cost optimization.
Experience designing or advising on end-to-end data architectures spanning operational databases, data integration, analytics, governance, and AI scenarios.
Consultative technical selling skills, including discovery, active listening, storytelling, objection handling, and influencing technical and business decision-makers.

Software Engineer II

Gaming? Check. Esports? Check. Hardware? Check. Software? Check. We could go on and on. The point is we've been helping gamers get better since 2001. In fact, Esports pros have won more money using SteelSeries products than any other brand and we're just getting started. Esports and Gaming are multi-billion-dollar industries, and we're going to continue supporting them through innovative gear and software gamers need and love. We believe in being true to the gaming community, which means being true to ourselves. We create products that help the best of the best be better, and products that help the not-so-good feel not-so-bad. Most of us are gamers, but you don't have to be, we promise! Just don't be surprised if you become one within a few weeks of starting!

We’re looking for engineers who value collective code ownership and take pride in finishing work properly — including writing the tests that make it robust. You’re open to mentoring others and just as open to being challenged and learning yourself. Across our product teams, we’re building software and services that come with meaningful technical complexity and real product impact. If you’re motivated by growth, enjoy thoughtful collaboration with engineers, designers, and product managers, and care deeply about improving both the codebase and the product experience, you’ll thrive here.

As a Software Engineer II you will be responsible for taking our gaming software platform, SteelSeries GG (steelseries.com/gg) & Nahimic (nahimic.com) to the next level. An ideal candidate is a data-minded full stack engineer that can make a huge impact on our product development, has experience developing desktop and/or web applications, and has a serious passion for technology.

3+ years of software engineering experience
Strong experience with C# and .NET application development
Experience developing Windows desktop applications using UWP, WinUI, WPF, or similar Windows application frameworks

Experience using Git and GitHub for source control, code reviews, and collaborative development

Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills

Strong communication skills and ability to work in an Agile development environment
Passion for learning new technologies and continuously improving engineering practices

Experience with Windows audio technologies, APIs, or multimedia application development
Experience working with audio products, gaming peripherals, or consumer electronics
Experience with ReactJS, JavaScript, TypeScript, or other modern web technologies
Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and DevOps practices

Become familiar with the Nahimic and SteelSeries software ecosystem, development processes, and engineering standards

Set up your development environment and understand the end-to-end software development and release process

Contribute to improving application stability, performance, and maintainability
Participate in technical discussions, code reviews, and architecture decisions

Evaluate new technologies, frameworks, AI-assisted development tools, and engineering practices, and recommend adoption where appropriate
Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues involving application, firmware, driver, and hardware interactions
